requirements.name: Git author identity
requirements.rationale: Agent commits must be attributable to a service or human identity.
requirements.guidance: Configure a dedicated Git user name and email for factory commits.

requirements.name: Source control token
requirements.rationale: Agents need repository access without credentials stored in prompts or files.
requirements.guidance: Store a least-privilege token in the factory secret store and expose it as SOURCE_CONTROL_TOKEN at runtime.

requirements.name: Secret owner and rotation
requirements.rationale: Factory credentials outlive individual sessions and need an owner.
requirements.guidance: Record an owner, expiry, and rotation procedure for every factory secret.

requirements.name: Repository reachable
requirements.rationale: The factory cannot start work if it cannot read the target repository.
requirements.guidance: Grant the factory identity read access to the repository and confirm its network path.

requirements.name: Work tracker connector
requirements.rationale: Agents need task context and a place to report status.
requirements.guidance: Connect the issue tracker or chat system with the least access needed to read tasks and post updates.

requirements.name: Git toolchain
requirements.rationale: Every software factory needs Git in its execution environment.
requirements.guidance: Install Git in the base environment or image used by agents.

requirements.name: Reproducible environment setup
requirements.rationale: Agents waste time and money when every session rebuilds setup by hand.
requirements.guidance: Keep environment setup in version control, pin toolchain versions, and rebuild cached images from it.

requirements.name: Required internet egress
requirements.rationale: Package registries and APIs blocked by egress policy cause late failures.
requirements.guidance: Allow only the hosts the factory needs, then add each critical host as a check.

requirements.name: Repository agent instructions
requirements.rationale: Agents follow project conventions more reliably when they are written down.
requirements.guidance: Add AGENTS.md with build, test, lint, and review instructions.

requirements.name: Approved model defaults
requirements.rationale: Unreviewed model choices create cost, data handling, and quality surprises.
requirements.guidance: Choose approved default models and data-retention settings for each agent workload.

requirements.name: Spend limits and alerts
requirements.rationale: Autonomous sessions can consume budget faster than human review cycles.
requirements.guidance: Set per-session or per-team limits and alert before they are reached.

requirements.name: Session audit trail
requirements.rationale: Teams need to reconstruct what an agent changed and why.
requirements.guidance: Retain session logs, cost records, and links between sessions, commits, and pull requests.

requirements.name: Human review before merge
requirements.rationale: Agent changes need the same review and branch protection as human changes.
requirements.guidance: Require review and passing checks on protected branches, and keep production credentials out of agent environments.
